name: Dism 图形界面
tagline: 微软商店里的系统优化与 DISM 图形工具
taglineEn: Graphical DISM and system maintenance tool from Microsoft Store
description: 把 DISM 等系统命令图形化的小工具（UWP 版本），不用记命令就能修复系统映像、清理组件、管理 Windows 系统，装在教室电脑上应急修系统很方便。
descriptionEn: A UWP tool that puts DISM and other system commands behind a graphical interface. Repair system images, clean up components and manage Windows without memorizing commands — handy for emergency repairs on classroom PCs.

downloads.platform: 通过 Microsoft Store 下载
